name: Nynomic AG
blurb: Nynomic (formerly known under earlier branding) is a German manufacturer of optical measurement and spectroscopy instruments used in industrial process control, agriculture, and medical diagnostics. It is not a photonics semiconductor company but rather an applied-optics instrumentation group — an adjacent beneficiary of the broader precision-optics and photonics supply chain rather than a direct player in AI data-centre optical interconnects.
recent: M7U appears in retail photonics watchlists as an adjacent beneficiary of the 2026 optical sector re-rating. Specific Q1 2026 financial data was not available in public search results at time of writing. The stock trades on the Frankfurt exchange; US retail access is typically via ADR or direct broker access to German equities. Coverage is thin in English-language financial media.
